notes: CLINICIAN ANCHOR: 'Berberine is a switch, not a foundation.' — hard rule; never maintenance.
PATIENT REASSURANCE (engine output): 'Symptoms returning usually means the system was challenged again — not that the treatment failed.'
QUICK DISCRIMINATOR: 'Does it throb/pulse?' → vessel-first. 'Does it burn/tighten/numb?' → nerve-first.
CHRONIC HEADACHE PRINCIPLE: 'Chronic headache is not escalation — it is migration.' Nerve → Vessel → Fascia progression.
LASER PRINCIPLE: 'Laser should follow the dominant failure layer, not the pain location.'

DEVICE HIERARCHY: Summus (clinic) = deep phase reset (mitochondria-fascia); Cell activator/Bioptron (home) = surface fascia maintenance. This is clinic → home → self-regulation hierarchy, NOT competition.

SHOULDER/HIP/SPINE PRINCIPLE: 'Frozen shoulder, hip and spine pain are rarely lack-of-Yang problems; they are interface and capsule problems (Shaoyang GB/TB line) that respond better to targeted Yang (laser + ECM modulation) than systemic heating.'
SEROTONIN ENGINE PRINCIPLE: 'Ondansetron and triptans are not opposites; they attempt to re-synchronise the same neurovascular-fascial continuum from different entry points.'
SYSTEM PHILOSOPHY: 'We don't just stop headaches. We restore the system that prevents them.'
AYURVEDA NOTE: Interface map provided as structural parallel only; do not merge TCM and Ayurveda pattern logics without explicit engine flag.
MIGRAINE WESTERN CRITERIA: ICHD-3 criteria extracted verbatim for red flag and diagnostic confirmation layer; engine must pass red flag screen before any recommendation output.
Riboflavin (B2) is evidence-supported for migraine prophylaxis — extract as standalone supplement with independent evidence base.
Sphenopalatine block noted as western prophylaxis option — flag for clinician referral pathway.

Shaoyang collapse cluster (migraine + TMJ + intercostal + hip + meralgia + knee + ankle + bursitis) = pattern recognition tool; note presence/absence; do not expand sub-patterns in initial triage pass.
